find: showExportNote(`${label} failed, so no file was saved: ${reason}`);
killedBy: the exports (issue #254) REPORTS a failure in the field instead of throwing, and saves nothing
the exports (issue #254) reports a download that throws, too
why: An export that fails throws out of the click handler instead of saying so in the pane. Issue #254 requires export failures to be reported; with this the field keeps whatever it said before, so the developer reads a stale line as the result of the press. RE-POINTED for issue #1014: an export now reads the session at the press and builds the file once the pane's modules are there, each half in its own `try`, and both report through the one `fail` this rethrows from -- the read half is what `REPORTS a failure` reaches, the build half `reports a download that throws`.
